== Notes ==
* After reaching the first [[allegiance rank]], Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, [[level]] 20 [[character]]s may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The [[skill icon]] for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* The effect [[Effect stacking|stacks]] with other skills that boost [[attribute#Temporary increase|attributes]].
* The Energy Storage-dependent gain is rounded down, i.e. you receive no energy unless you have at least rank 10 in the attribute and can receive at most 2 energy with rank 20 or higher.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any [[Energy#Cost modifiers|modifiers]], such as [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]] or [[Quickening Zephyr]].

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
